description: Delete a category. Its transactions and planned operations are moved to move_to (merge categories) or, with uncategorize=true, left without this category. Subcategories must be moved or deleted first.

dry_run.description: Preview the outcome without saving anything

move_to.description: Category that takes over its transactions

uncategorize.description: Confirm removing the category from its transactions and planned operations when move_to is not given

name: delete_category
title: Delete category
